comment: (B) A PRE-PASS CONVOKE TAPS ITS BODIES AT ITS OWN STEP. T4, four Forests and two non-sick Kitchen Finks, hand Llanowar Elves + Chord of Calling (Melira in the library); the human queues Elves, then Chord. Before: Chord's convoke bodies were tapped in the pre-cast pass, ahead of every cast -- the Elves was not on the battlefield yet, so both Finks were tapped and nothing attacked (the "*" pin still ends at 20). Now the convoke happens at Chord's step, after the Elves resolved: the summoning-sick Elves is a legal (free) body, one Finks stays untapped and attacks: 20 - 3 = 17.
